status: Descriptive paired diagnostics; not a causal or prospective contrast
interpretation: Positive values mean lower MAE with ordinary calendar inputs. Mean within-state/year relative effects, equal states then years, not ratio of macro MASE.
limits: These inputs are weekdays/Fourier terms, not added festival identities. Small or mixed gains alone do not establish an information mechanism. All cases/years/variants retained; no model, feature or future forecast selected from the results.
